event_chain.summary: Shipping data stolen from CEVA systems

summary: Beginning around July 29, 2026 attackers intruded into systems supporting eight European warehouses of France-headquartered CEVA Logistics and stole shipping data, including names, home addresses, phone numbers and email addresses of customers of retailers and other clients that use CEVA. CEVA confirmed the intrusion to customers on August 1. The attack delayed shipments and led to canceled orders; Bol, De Bijenkorf, Ajax, ING, Ace & Tate and Valve (Steam hardware buyers) all warned customers, and the Dutch data protection authority received reports from at least 10 organizations. CEVA did not say how many people were affected or whether a ransom was demanded.
